newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NorScan stock unchanged or little down Dec - source.
newsitem.headline: NorScan stock unchanged or little down Dec - source.

text.p: Producer stocks of long fibre paper pulp in North America and Scandinavia, the so called NorScan stocks, were unchanged or a little lower in December, one industry source told Reuters.
"It is up in Sweden to a little over three weeks deliveries but in Canada stocks were a little lower," said the source.
There was still no information from the U.S. producers.
"I would think that stocks are unchanged or marginally down," he said.
He said European pulp buyers seemed to have ground down their stocks in December but activity was higher in January.
NorScan stocks rose in November to almost 1.9 million tonnes.
